bio.text: Ty Masterson, a Republican, is the Republican nominee for Governor of Kansas in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Cindy Holscher.
He has represented District 16 (Butler County) in the Kansas Senate since 2009 and serves as President of the Senate.
He previously served in the Kansas House of Representatives from 2005 to 2008.

sources.title: In Kansas governor's race, Republican Ty Masterson will face Democrat Cindy Holscher
